provenance.equation: Driven differential-pair-integrator trace with nine i_mem>=i_threshold resets; the current-mode leaky-integrator membrane tau dI_mem/dt = -I_mem + gain*I_syn + I_leak is advanced with the exact explicit-Euler recurrence, independently re-derived from the DYNAP-SE DPI neuron (Chicca et al. 2014) including the i_mem=i_reset threshold reset. The drive is non-negative, so the source model's max(i_mem, 0) current rectification is inert and omitted.
